description: This Java class 'ImportHandlerUtils' provides utility methods for handling Excel sheet import operations within the Fineract project's bulk import feature. It includes functions for reading various data types from Excel rows and cells, managing cell styles, and retrieving specific data based on sheet and cell content. The class is designed to facilitate robust and flexible data import processes, handling common Excel data types and exceptions.

classes.name: ImportHandlerUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for importing and processing data from Excel sheets in bulk import operations.

methods.name: getNumberOfRows
methods.description: Counts the number of rows in the sheet starting from the second row until a blank or null cell is encountered in the primary column.

methods.name: isNotImported
methods.description: Checks if the given row's status cell indicates that the row has not been imported based on a specific status constant.

methods.name: readAsLong
methods.description: Reads a cell value as a Long, evaluating formulas if necessary.

methods.name: readAsString
methods.description: Reads a cell value as a trimmed String, evaluating formulas if necessary, and handling numeric and boolean types.

methods.name: trimEmptyDecimalPortion
methods.description: Removes the '.0' decimal part from numeric string representations.

methods.name: readAsDate
methods.description: Reads a cell value as a LocalDate.

methods.name: readAsBoolean
methods.description: Reads a cell value as a Boolean, evaluating formulas if necessary.

methods.name: readAsInt
methods.description: Reads a cell value as an Integer, evaluating formulas if necessary.

methods.name: readAsDouble
methods.description: Reads a cell value as a Double, evaluating formulas if necessary.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Creates or updates a cell in the row with a String value.

methods.name: getCellStyle
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cell style with a specified background color, caching styles for efficiency.

methods.name: getDefaultUserMessages
methods.description: Concatenates a list of ApiParameterError messages into a single tab-separated string.

methods.name: getErrorList
methods.description: Concatenates a list of error strings into a single string.

methods.name: writeErrorMessage
methods.description: Writes an error message into a specific row and column, applying a red cell style.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message from various exception types.

methods.name: getIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves an ID from a sheet based on matching a name, considering sheet-specific column offsets.

methods.name: getChargeTimeTypeEmun
methods.description: Retrieves an EnumOptionData for charge time types based on a string name, specific to the charge sheet.

methods.name: getChargeAmountTypeEnum
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for charge amount types based on string input.

methods.name: getCodeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a code from a sheet based on a name, specifically for the 'extras' sheet.

methods.name: getFrequencyId
methods.description: Maps frequency descriptive strings to their corresponding IDs.

methods.name: getRepeatsOnDayId
methods.description: Maps day names to their corresponding IDs.
